name: Windsurf
tagline: Codeium is a free AI-powered code completion and chat tool that works inside VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim, and 40+ other editors. It offers real-time autocomplete, natural-language code search, and an in-editor chat assistant powered by its own foundation models. Unlike many rivals it has a generous free tier with no token limits.
